incident-bot: PAGER: P1 Alert fired — Eval-gate safety regression on route /v1/chat (prod-realtime-us). PagerDuty ID PD-INC-5432. Trigger: safety_eval_set_2026 exceeded threshold (safety_fail_rate). Auto-escalation allocated to oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-INC-5432

pagerduty: Alert details:
- Service: eval-gate-monitoring
- Trigger: safety_fail_rate > 0.03 for 5m
- Current value: 0.082
- Model variant: q4_8_optimized:v2026-03-12 (canary ~12% traffic)
- Affected routes: /v1/chat (canary traffic), /v1/generate (low)

maya.chen: Acked. I'm on it. Jumping in as primary. Any customer tickets yet? :eyes:

jordan.k: We're seeing a spike in user-reported safety incidents (abusive / hallucination-related). Correlates with the canary rollout timestamp ~2026-03-12T02:10Z. Canary weight 12%.

samir: Quick eval dump from the gate:
```
Model: q4_8_optimized:v2026-03-12
Eval set: safety_eval_set_2026
Metric: safety_fail_rate
Baseline (prod-safe-ensemble:v2.1): 0.030
Current: 0.082
Delta: +0.052 (173% relative increase)
Top fail samples: sample_1023, sample_2048, sample_3051
```
This looks like a real regression, not noise.

olga: Can we hold traffic to the safe variant and cut canary? I can run a rollback. Proposed command: 
```
# force 100% traffic to safe ensemble immediately
redwood routing update /v1/chat --model safe-ensemble:v2.1 --weight 100 --force
```

eng-oncall-bot: Initiating routing change: `redwood routing update` submitted by olga. Job ID: job-77421. Estimated propagation 30s — 2m.

incident-bot: Deploybot: routing change accepted. Job job-77421 started. Old weights: q4_8_optimized:12%, safe-ensemble:v2.1:88%. New weights pending: safe-ensemble:v2.1:100%. Logs:
```
[00:00:05] job-77421: locking route /v1/chat
[00:00:22] job-77421: updating routing table
[00:00:45] job-77421: propagated to region prod-realtime-us
[00:01:10] job-77421: completed, verification checks running\```

jordan.k: Monitoring logs — seeing drop in safety failures after propagation. Good. Thanks olga.

maya.chen: I'll notify customers on the few support tickets and post a short status on status.redwood.ai. Drafting now: "We detected a model regression in a canary rollout causing unexpected outputs; we reverted to the previous safe model and are investigating."

samir: Also disabling auto-promote / canary pipeline for q4_8_optimized:v2026-03-12 until we root cause. I'll open an eval-traces artifact and start a deeper diff (prompt-level).

olga: Filed rollback PR and added a temporary routing policy: fallback_to_safety=true for 24h. Command used:
```
redwood routing patch /v1/chat --set fallback_to_safety=true --ttl 24h
```

eng-oncall-bot: PagerDuty PD-INC-5432 acknowledged by maya.chen at 2350000068. Incident severity remains P1 while investigating.

jordan.k: Early hypothesis: quantization changes in q4_8_optimized (kernel selection + attention fudge) altered tokenization/answering heuristics for short prompts causing safety triggers. Samir, can you diff the tokenizer outputs for the failing samples?

samir: On it. I'll push a trace bundle to S3: s3://redwood-eval-traces/PD-5432/235000. Includes model logits, tokenization, eval prompts, and topk candidates.

maya.chen: Customer comms posted to status page and CS triage notified. Adding a line to say "no systemic downtime; routing reverted; we'll provide a follow-up with root cause and remediation timeline." :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Update: job-77421 verification checks passed. Safety monitor re-evaluating gate. Current safety_fail_rate (window 5m): 0.028 — under threshold.

olga: Leaving the rollback in place. We'll hold canary at 0% and start a blocked rollout ticket for model owners.

samir: Started analysis. Preliminary notes: top failing prompts show a shift toward generation of ungrounded statements when prompt length < 32 tokens. Possible beam/decoding tweak in the optimized kernels.

maya.chen: Going to open an enterprise customer DM for the handful of affected customers and offer a call if they want more detail.

eng-oncall-bot: Monitoring window started. Will check back in 45m and 2h. PagerDuty: PD-INC-5432 status -> investigating -> mitigated (routing rollback) -> awaiting RCA.

incident-bot: PD-INC-5432 update: acknowledged by maya.chen, mitigation applied (routing rollback), severity lowered to P2 for RCA tracking.

jordan.k: Please ensure the eval gate config has logging retained for 90 days for this model so we can replay. Also tag traces with `incident:PD-5432`.

samir: Done. Trace bundle tagged and retained. Starting postmortem doc: docs/incidents/PD-5432-postmortem (draft). I'll include sample diffs and recommended rollback criteria for future canaries.

maya.chen: Thanks everyone. I'll lead the customer-facing summary and coordinate the postmortem. Reopen PD if we see a reoccurrence. :handshake:
